name: Pipeliners - SEO Case Study Mar-Aug 2026
body:
> Report · Pipeliners · 2026-09-14

# Summary
A 6-page SEO case study (PDF plus `pipeliners-seo-case-study.html` source in `portfolio\`), built Sep 14 and restyled to the Pipeliners brand with the logo removed. Written in Kim's voice as SEO Specialist, TAG Marketing. Data: GSC URL-prefix property pulled Sep 15; Mar 1 to Aug 31, 2026 vs Sep 2025 to Feb 2026.

# Headline numbers
- Impressions +46% (124.7k vs 85.7k; monthly average 20,786 vs 14,276).
- Average position 55.7 to 48.2; mobile 58.0 to 40.9 with mobile CTR up 47%.
- Indexed pages 72 to 105 (GSC Pages report, June to early September).
- Mobile PageSpeed 21 to 43.
- Clicks held steady (213 vs 211); first matched 28-day read +27% (30 to 38).
- All 19 city pages with 1,000+ impressions moved up (median 10 places; Buckeye 40 to 26, Tempe 47 to 32). Main service page inbound links 35 to 74.

# Story
Diagnosis graded like a sewer camera report (brand-only traffic, city pages seen but not clicked, pages missing from Google, templated city pages with wrong-city leaks, site hygiene, slow mobile), then month-by-month work (April cleanup, June indexing and posts, July speed and monsoon cluster, August city page rebuild), judgment calls (dropped gas-line targeting, protected the paid page, paused OTTO autopilot, corrected a mismatched-window read, verified from outside) and limits (clicks still the open problem, URL-prefix property undercounts GBP clicks, Ads conversion tracking broken since late July).
